doc.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
doc.interviewee: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack")

title: Tony Jackson at the Deluxe
summary: Allen asks about Tony Jackson, a New Orleans pianist and singer whom Billy heard at the Deluxe. They try to recall a song of his. Billy marvels at the names he remembered.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: About what year was that? Can you remember when? 9 and 10, 99, 1910. When he was along the Gulf Coast with you? Yes, yes. One other man I was going to ask about, Tony Jackson, if you ever worked with him or remember?
Yes, it was a pint, a half pint?
Tony Jackson, not, not, uh... Not Frank Jack... Oh, yeah, half pint. Tony Jackson was a piano player.
Uh-huh, I was thinking about this little Jackson.
Oh, yeah, half pint Jackson, yes.
He was from New Orleans. Yeah. And he was, uh, he used to play at the Deluxe, too. He used to sing, he used to sing a song called, uh...
He wrote Pretty Baby was one of his numbers. Do you remember that?

Yeah, well this thing, I don't know whether he wrote it or not, uh, and I can't even think of it now, but I have a... After a while or all the while or something about it with the word while in it. Mm-hmm. And the cold winter it blow, snow and blow, you know, I remember some of the rhymes. Yeah, snow and ice, maybe.
Yeah, and the ice and the snow.
Yeah, it was published. I have the music for it. Yeah, yeah. But there was another name they used for it, too, and I forget that name, too.
Well, Tony Jackson, the first time I heard it, that's what he was singing. He sang that here at the Deluxe.
You know it's good for people to think of those things when you can't think now. Who would ever think of Tony Jackson, all of them?
Maybe just as it would run across your mind, you know?
Well, how did I think of all these names? Now, yes, there's about 20 names down here that I'd never think of otherwise.
